Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0106. ORIGINAL sources are authority for icon geometry and fine control anatomy. Input roles: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: edit-target-generated-candidate. Image 3: secondary-Japanese-typography-and-content-mock. Image 4: approved-style-reference. Preserve locked Japanese typography and content. Official pure-white/forest-green/slate design remains binding.
Edit v001 while preserving its five Japanese strings, typography, dark primary values, muted labels, disabled gray action, downward Region chevron, and white surface. Target the same approximately 360x240 logical canvas. Correct the horizontal scale to match the source crop and Japanese mock: use about 26px left/right insets, so the Region underline is about 308px wide, both labels start at x≈26, the chevron sits at the right edge of that field, and the disabled 更新 pill is about 308px wide and centered. Set the button height to about 44px while keeping the disabled state. Keep the current balanced vertical placement with a modest top margin and bottom margin; do not reintroduce excess whitespace and do not compress the field groups. Preserve exact text: 地域; 米国; 言語; 英語; 更新. Meiryo Regular 12px/16px muted labels, Meiryo Regular 14px/24px values, Meiryo Bold 14px/24px disabled button label. Add no title, navigation chrome, icons, extra lines, cards, shadows, or gradients.
reviewNotes: Candidate-only; v002 needs correction: actual-size review shows line and button still too wide at about 14px insets; source/mock use about 26px. No native or application acceptance claimed.
